newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon construction activity fell in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon construction activity fell in 1996.

text.p: Lebanon's construction activity slowed in 1996 from a year ago, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin issued on Tuesday.
"The area of construction permits approved to December by the Association of Engineers declined by 60.9 percent from the levels recorded in 1995," the report said.
"In fact, construction permits have been revealing a continuous downward trend since the beginning of the year," it said.

Cement deliveries were 3.8 million tonnes during 1996, a 3.9-percent decrease year-on-year. However, total real estate fees collected jumped 27.6 percent during 1996 to reach 283.6 billion Lebanese pounds, the report added.
($1 = 1,552 Lebanese pounds at end of December 1996)
